review_notes: Segment 0: The token 'तदुपदिदिक्षुः' appears garbled/uncertain; I preserved the original wording rather than guess a correction.
Segment 0: Phrases like 'एतदन्तेन' and 'जीवादि' may be mistranscribed ASR artifacts; left unchanged to avoid altering doctrinal meaning. Please review these for possible Sanskrit corrections.

Segment 1: Certain lexical items appear uncertain or possibly mistranscribed and should be checked by a human reviewer if doctrinal accuracy is required: 'सात्पत्ये ब्राह्मणे' (may be misrecognized), 'नोयमात्मा' (unclear token), and 'युद्धानम्' in the clause 'इति युद्धानम् आत्मानम्…' — these may be ASR artifacts or speaker pronunciations and were left unchanged per conservative policy.

Segment 1: Multiple Sanskritized/Hindi compounds have been left as in the raw transcript when their intended canonical forms were uncertain; please verify phrases against the lecture audio if exact Sanskrit wording is important.

Segment 2: The Sanskrit clause 'तत्रैवं धर्मसंमूढचेतसो महति शोकसागरे निमग्नस्य अर्जुनस्य अन्यत्र आत्मज्ञानात् उद्धरणम् अपश्यन् भगवान् वासुदेवः ततः अर्जुनम् उद्दिधारयिषुः आत्मज्ञानाय अवतारयन्न् आह।' contains several verb forms (उद्धरणम् अपश्यन्, उद्दिधारयिषुः, अवतारयन्न् आह) that are uncertain as ASR renderings; left unchanged but should be reviewed by a human familiar with the source.
Segment 2: The term 'प्रकरणशो' may be an ASR error (could be 'प्रकरणशः' or another form); preserved as in raw but flag for review.

Segment 3: शंकराचार्य द्वारा उद्धृत वाक्य/श्लोक "यावत् वित्तोपार्जनसक्तः तावन्निज परिवारो रक्तः" ट्रांसक्रिप्शन की शुद्धता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए मानव-समीक्षा की आवश्यकता हो सकती है; ज्यों का त्यों बरकरार रखा गया है।

Segment 4: Please verify the intended Sanskrit phrases quoted at the start ('एषाम् मम इति', 'अहम् एषाम् मम इति') against the original audio/speaker, as the exact transliteration and sandhi may affect doctrinal nuance.

Segment 4: Confirm the exact wording of the Guru Nanak line ("जगत में झूठी देखी प्रीत, अपने ही सुख सो सब लाग्यो, क्या दारा क्या मीत") with the speaker/audio — minor variations in transliteration ('सो' vs 'सों') may reflect dialectal or source text differences.

Segment 5: Left unchanged but flagged for human review: 'आबाल-वृद्ध, इपीलिका' — these terms look like ASR artifacts or unusual compound; could be intended words like 'बाल-वृद्ध' / 'नन्हे से' / 'शिशु से' but uncertain.

Segment 5: The phrase 'कपटी कुटिल मोहि प्रभु...' appears to be a quoted Sanskrit/Hindi devotional line or idiomatic phrase; preserved as in raw transcript but may merit review against canonical wording.
Segment 5: English code-switches (e.g., 'Look at this.', 'blaming so much') were preserved as spoken.
Segment 5: Punctuation and sentence boundaries were normalized in several places to improve readability while preserving speaker order and meaning.

Segment 6: The term 'ससीम' appears repeatedly and may be an ASR error (possible intended words: 'सीमित', 'असीम', or 'सीमता'). I preserved 'ससीम' because changing it could alter nuance; please verify with the speaker recording.

Segment 6: The original raw segment ended abruptly after 'व्याकुल'. I retained the sense of the sentence and added final punctuation, but the trailing fragment in the raw may indicate missing audio — human review recommended to confirm the intended ending.
Segment 7: The term 'पनही' (used for 'जूता') was left as in the raw transcript; confirm whether the speaker intended 'पनही' (regional/archaic) or 'पहनही'/'पनही' spelling variants.
Segment 7: The correction 'विज्ञानसारथिर्यस्तु' is made with medium confidence based on the following context; please verify against the speaker's intended Sanskrit phrasing.

Segment 7: The rephrasing of the sentence about अध्यात्मशास्त्र (to '...बहुत प्रशंसा नहीं की जा सकती।') is a grammatical correction with medium confidence—confirm it matches the speaker's original emphasis and tone.
Segment 7: No changes were made to colloquial English insertions (e.g., 'It is all connected', 'नथिंग डूइंग')—these are preserved as spoken code-switching.
Segment 8: प्रविष्ट में कुछ शब्द-अंश (जैसे 'संहारोदर') स्पष्ट नहीं लगते; संदर्भ के अनुसार ASR त्रुटि हो सकती है — मानव समीक्षा सुझावित।
Segment 8: 'नाव पे रहता है अंदर' वाक्यांश असहज लगता है; मूल कथन 'नाव में रहता है' या 'नाव पर रहता है' हो सकता है — पुष्टि हेतु समीक्षा उपयोगी।

Segment 8: श्रुति उद्धरण/संस्कृत श्लोक ('विज्ञानसारथिर्यस्तु मनः प्रग्रहवान् नरः' आदि) का मूलपाठ सत्यापित करने हेतु परीक्षा-समर्थक संदर्भ देखना उपयोगी हो सकता है, पर मैंने मूल शब्दावली जैसा पड़ा है वैसा ही रखा है।
Segment 9: Phrase 'प्रज्ञा अपराध देखो' is unclear in meaning — please verify against audio (possible ASR or word-choice issue).
Segment 9: Sanskrit-like phrase 'सो विज्ञान सारथिर्यस्तु' may be mis-transcribed; verify exact Sanskrit wording from audio.
Segment 9: The expression 'बालवत हँसते थे' (start of segment) is unusual; confirm speaker's words from audio.
Segment 10: Corrected 'जीवोस्मि' → 'जीवोऽस्मि' (sanskrit). While this is a standard Sanskrit form, please verify against the speaker's exact pronunciation/text if precise transliteration matters.
Segment 10: Corrected 'ससीम' → 'सीमित' based on context ('सीमित अहं' earlier). If speaker intentionally used a colloquial or Sanskrit form 'ससीम', review and confirm.
Segment 10: Removed duplicated 'प्रत्यय है, प्रत्यय है' as likely ASR duplication; if the speaker intentionally repeated for emphasis, please restore.

Segment 11: The phrase "मैं और तोर, तोर तैं, मैं और मोर, तोर тैं माया" appears to be a colloquial/quoted line and may contain ASR errors or dialectal forms. Preserve as spoken, but recommend human review for intended wording or canonical source.

Segment 11: Several Sanskrit-formula fragments (e.g., "अहमिदं ममेदं", "अहमेतेषाम् मम एते") show variant transcriptions; I preserved the raw forms except for very minor spacing normalization. Please verify against the speaker's original or preferred diacritics if precise Sanskrit rendering is required.

Segment 11: A quoted verse/line beginning 'तो ताकर भेद सुनौ तुम दो, विद्या अपर अविद्या दो...' may be from Ramayan/Ramcharitmanas; its exact orthography was left as in the transcript. Recommend human check if canonical accuracy is needed.
Segment 12: The opening phrase 'मम माया दुरत्यया। दुरमगाह्या' is unclear — verify the exact Sanskrit/Hindi wording (possible ASR ambiguity).
Segment 12: The clause 'कथमेष आगतः, कथं प्रतिष्ठास्य कुतो निवृत्तिः' appears to be a citation/verse fragment; consider verifying exact transliteration/wording of the original source.
Segment 14: No substantive lexical or Sanskrit-wording changes were made; edits are limited to punctuation to improve sentence boundaries and clarity.
Segment 14: Speaker's phrasing, repetitions, and code-switching (Hindi/Sanskrit) are preserved as in the original.

changes.original: त्विममं
changes.corrected: त्वम् इमम्
changes.reason: ASR concatenation of two Sanskrit words in the Bhagavad-gītā quotation; restored expected separation 'त्वम् इमम्' (त्वम् इमम् धर्म्यं सङ्ग्रामं).

changes.original: तस्मात्त्वम्
changes.corrected: तस्मात् त्वम्
changes.reason: Inserted space between sandhied words to reflect correct word boundary 'तस्मात् त्वम्'.

changes.original: उचिता
changes.corrected: उचिता
changes.reason: Corrected likely ASR misspelling to the Sanskrit form 'उचिता' (appropriate).

changes.original: त्विमां
changes.corrected: त्वम् इमाम्
changes.reason: ASR concatenation of pronoun + demonstrative in the phrase '...बुद्धिर्योगे त्वम् इमाम् शृणु'; restored separation and correct inflected form 'इमाम्'.

changes.original: तत्रैव च प्राक् दारपरिग्रहात् पुरुषात्मा प्राकृतः धर्मजिज्ञासा उत्तरकालं लोकत्रयसाधनं पुत्रं द्विप्रकारं च वित्तं मानुषं दैवं च, तत्र मानुषं वित्तं कर्मरूपं, पितृलोकप्राप्तिसाधनं, विद्यां च दैवं वित्तं देवलोकप्राप्तिसाधनं सो कामयत इति।
changes.corrected: तत्रैव च प्राक् दारपरिग्रहात् पुरुषात्मा प्राकृतः धर्मजिज्ञासा। उत्तरकालं लोकत्रयसाधनं पुत्रं द्विप्रकारं च वित्तं मानुषं दैवं च। तत्र मानुषं वित्तं कर्मरूपं, पितृलोकप्राप्तिसाधनं। विद्यां च दैवं वित्तं देवलोकप्राप्तिसाधनं सो कामयत इति।
changes.reason: Inserted sentence boundaries to separate clauses for clarity (split running clause into shorter sentences). These are punctuation/sentence-boundary edits, not content changes.

changes.original: तेभ्यो विरक्ताय प्रव्रजन्ति इति युद्धानम् आत्मानम् एव लोकम् इच्छतः अकामस्य विहितम्।
changes.corrected: तेभ्यो विरक्ताय प्रव्रजन्ति। इति युद्धानम् आत्मानम् एव लोकम् इच्छतः अकामस्य विहितम्।
changes.reason: Split the clause after 'प्रव्रजन्ति' to make the quoted 'इति' clause a separate sentence, improving sentence boundaries.

changes.original: अथ अर्जुनस्य भगवत् उक्तवचनार्थ विवेकानवधारणनिमित्तः प्रश्नः कल्प्येत, तथापि भगवता प्रश्नानुरूपं प्रतिवचनं देयम्।
changes.corrected: अथ अर्जुनस्य भगवत् उक्तवचनार्थ विवेकानवधारणनिमित्तः प्रश्नः कल्प्येत। तथापि भगवता प्रश्नानुरूपं प्रतिवचनं देयम्।
changes.reason: Replaced comma with a sentence boundary to separate concessive clause for clarity; preserves original meaning.

changes.original: मृषैव ज्यायसी चेत् कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिरिति।
changes.corrected: मृषा एव ज्यायसी चेत् कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिरिति।
changes.reason: Added space between 'मृषा' and 'एव' to reflect standard spacing ('मृषा एव') — a high-confidence orthographic correction.

changes.original: न कर्म समुच्चितात् इति निश्चितः अर्थः।
changes.corrected: न कर्मसमुच्चयात् इति निश्चितः अर्थः।
changes.reason: Probable ASR error: 'समुच्चितात्' is unlikely in context; 'समुच्चयात्' matches earlier use of 'समुच्चय' and the intended sense.

changes.original: यथा च अयमर्थः तथा प्रकरणशो विभज्य तत्र तत्र दर्शयिष्यामः।
changes.corrected: यथा च अयं अर्थः तथा प्रकरणशो विभज्य तत्र तत्र दर्शयिष्यामः।
changes.reason: 'अयमर्थः' appears to be an ASR concatenation; corrected to 'अयं अर्थः' to reflect the intended phrase 'this meaning'.

changes.original: तस्मात् गीतासु केवलादेव तत्त्वज्ञानात् मोक्षप्राप्तिः, न कर्म समुच्चितात् इति निश्चितः अर्थः। यथा च अयमर्थः
changes.corrected: तस्मात् गीतासु केवलादेव तत्त्वज्ञानात् मोक्षप्राप्तिः, न कर्मसमुच्चयात् इति निश्चितः अर्थः। यथा च अयं अर्थः
changes.reason: Adjusted spacing/punctuation and combined the corrected Sanskrit term into the sentence to improve sentence boundary clarity.

changes.original: ये प्रमाण प्रत्यय न होकर के भ्रांत प्रत्यय हैं।
changes.corrected: ये प्रमाण प्रत्यय न होकर भ्रांत प्रत्यय हैं।
changes.reason: Removed an extraneous colloquial filler 'के' to correct the phrase and improve fluency without changing meaning.

changes.original: प्रत्यहम् एषाम् मम इते, अहम् एषाम् मम इते हैं,
changes.corrected: जो जो 'एषाम् मम इति', 'अहम् एषाम् मम इति' हैं,
changes.reason: Corrected apparent ASR transcription of Sanskrit phrases to a clearer form ('एषाम् मम इति', 'अहम् एषाम् मम इति') and adjusted surrounding words for grammatical clarity.

changes.original: अपने ही सुख सों सब लाग्यो,
changes.corrected: अपने ही सुख सो सब लाग्यो,
changes.reason: Corrected 'सों' to the more likely 'सो' in the Hindi rendering of the quoted line.

changes.original: यस, देह के स्तर पे ज़रूर सिद्ध होती है।
changes.corrected: हाँ, देह के स्तर पर ज़रूर सिद्ध होती है।
changes.reason: Replaced English/'यस' with Hindi 'हाँ' and normalized 'पे' to 'पर' for standard Hindi usage.

changes.original: यह जो दो प्रत्यय हैं, अहं एवं मम एते,
changes.corrected: यह जो दो प्रत्यय हैं, अहं और मम,
changes.reason: Normalized the phrasing to clearer Hindi ('अहं और मम') from mixed/uncertain transliteration.

changes.original: जीव भाव मने ससीम अहं की अनुभूति,
changes.corrected: जीव भाव, माने सीमित अहं की अनुभूति,
changes.reason: Fixed misrecognized words: 'मने ससीम' -> 'माने सीमित' and added punctuation to clarify the explanatory clause.

changes.original: एक परिछिन्न अस्तित्व के रूप में
changes.corrected: एक परिच्छिन्न अस्तित्व के रूप में
changes.reason: Corrected spelling of 'परिछिन्न' to 'परिच्छिन्न'.

changes.original: क्षेत्र बदलेगा, धनी धन बढ़ाने का प्रयास करता है, साधक साधना बढ़ाने का प्रयास करता है, लेकिन बढ़ाना सभी चाहते हैं।
changes.corrected: क्षेत्र बदलेगा। धनी व्यक्ति धन बढ़ाने का प्रयास करता है; साधक साधना बढ़ाने का प्रयास करता है। लेकिन बढ़ाना सभी चाहते हैं।
changes.reason: Probable ASR duplication/omission: inserted 'व्यक्ति' to make phrase grammatical and removed awkward single-clause listing by adding sentence/semicolon to clarify parallel examples.

changes.original: कदाचित आ गया, तुलसी सूर जैसे लोगों के मन में, तो वो रोने लगते हैं।

changes.reason: Likely intended reference to poets 'तुलसीदास' and 'सूरदास' rather than 'तुलसी सूर'; also adjusted punctuation to separate clauses.

changes.original: मौसम कौन कुटिल, खल, कामी, माने blaming so much.
changes.corrected: मन में कौन कुटिल, खल, कामी, माने blaming so much.
changes.reason: 'मौसम' appears to be an ASR error; 'मन में' fits the intended sense ('in the mind').

changes.original: तो कोई काम ही थोड़े होते हैं, लेकिन जहाँ ब्रह्मचर्य व्रत की अधिकता हो, वहाँ पर एक कोई वृत्ति कभी आ गई, बस।
